description: Validates the full installer workflow: wizard interaction, step execution, artifact verification. Driven by declarative JSON config.

setup.title: Prerequisites gate check
setup.description: Verifies Chapter 1 (Prerequisites) passed. Fails immediately if the gate flag is not set.

actions.code: (() => { if (String(window._e2ePrerequisitesPassed) !== 'true') throw new Error('Chapter 1 (Prerequisites) did not pass. Fix prerequisites first.'); return 'ok'; })()

setup.title: Ensure installer wizard modal is open
setup.description: Checks if the installer wizard modal is already visible. If not (e.g. closed by prior chapter teardown), re-opens it via the flowti:open-installer command.

actions.description: Open installer wizard via command if not already visible
Wait for modal to render after command
Installer wizard modal is present in DOM

steps.title: Wizard modal opens on plugin load
steps.description: Verifies the installer wizard modal is present in the DOM. Prerequisites enabled the plugin with installer state reset — the wizard opened automatically.
steps.expectedInput: Plugin enabled by Prerequisites, installer state reset
steps.expectedOutput: .flowti-installer-modal element is present in the DOM

actions.description: Installer wizard modal is in DOM

steps.title: Welcome page is displayed
steps.description: Verifies the wizard starts on the Welcome page with the correct heading, a name input field, and role selector cards.
steps.expectedOutput: Heading contains 'Welcome', name input with placeholder exists, at least 2 enabled role cards visible

actions.code: (() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.flowti-installer-modal .ft-role-card-enabled').length; if (cards < 2) throw new Error('Expected at least 2 role cards, found: ' + cards); return 'ok'; })()

actions.label: welcome-page
actions.description: Welcome page with name input and role cards

steps.title: Enter username
steps.description: Types 'E2E Tester' into the name input field using the native HTMLInputElement value setter to trigger the onChange callback.
steps.expectedInput: Welcome page with empty name input

actions.code: (() => { const input = document.querySelector('.flowti-installer-modal input[placeholder="Enter your name"]'); if (!input) throw new Error('Name input not found'); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(input, 'E2E Tester'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return input.value; })()
actions.description: Set name input via native setter

steps.title: Select user role
steps.description: Selects the 'user' role by clicking the first enabled role card.
steps.expectedInput: Welcome page with name filled in

steps.title: Navigate to Review page
steps.description: Clicks the 'Next' button to advance from Welcome to Review page.
steps.expectedOutput: Review page heading: 'Ready to set up your vault?'

actions.description: Click Next to advance to Review

steps.title: Review page shows correct settings
steps.description: Validates the Review page displays the entered user name, selected role badge, folder structure preview, and sample content toggle.
steps.expectedOutput: Shows 'E2E Tester' as name, 'User' as role badge, folder list, sample content toggle

steps.title: Start installation
steps.description: Clicks the 'Install' button on the Review page. This triggers InstallerService.runAll() which executes all 3 installer steps.

steps.title: Installation completes successfully
steps.description: Waits for the installer to finish all 3 steps and verifies the modal transitions to the completion page.

steps.title: Installer events confirm all steps passed
steps.description: Reads the EventBus trace to verify all 3 installer steps emitted completion events and the overall installer.completed event fired.

actions.code: (() => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; const trace = p?._e2eEventTrace ?? []; const stepEvents = trace.filter(e => e.type === 'installer.step.completed'); if (stepEvents.length < 3) throw new Error('Expected 3 step completions, got ' + stepEvents.length); const completeEvents = trace.filter(e => e.type === 'installer.completed'); if (completeEvents.length === 0) throw new Error('installer.completed not found in trace'); return 'ok (' + stepEvents.length + ' steps)'; })()
actions.description: Verify 3 step completions and overall completion in trace

steps.title: Complete page shows success message
steps.description: Verifies the completion page displays a success alert with the user's name and a summary of all completed steps.
steps.expectedOutput: Success alert contains 'E2E Tester', step summary list present

actions.code: (() => { const count = document.querySelectorAll('.flowti-installer-modal .ft-step-status-icon').length; if (count < 3) throw new Error('Expected 3+ step summaries, found: ' + count); return 'ok'; })()
actions.description: At least 3 step status icons present

steps.title: Close the wizard
steps.description: Clicks the 'Close' button on the completion page to dismiss the installer wizard modal.
steps.expectedInput: On complete page with success state

steps.title: User was created with correct profile
steps.description: Reads the created user via UserService and verifies the name and role match what was entered in the wizard.

actions.code: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; const svc = await p.getService('userService'); const u = svc.getUser(); if (!u) throw new Error('No user found'); if (u.name !== 'E2E Tester') throw new Error('User name: ' + u.name); if (u.role !== 'user') throw new Error('User role: ' + u.role); return 'ok'; })()
actions.description: Verify user name and role via UserService

steps.title: Folder structure was scaffolded
steps.description: Spot-checks key folders from the scaffold by querying app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath() for each.

actions.code: (() => { const folders = ['00 - Connectivity/inbox', '03 - Resources/Sample Data', '03 - Resources/Documentation', '04 - Archive', 'var/data']; for (const f of folders) { if (!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(f)) throw new Error('Folder not found: ' + f); } return 'ok (' + folders.length + ' folders)'; })()

steps.title: Welcome note was created with correct content
steps.description: Reads the Welcome to Flowti.md file and verifies it contains the expected content.
steps.expectedOutput: File exists and contains Flowti-related content

actions.code: (async () => { const path = '00 - Connectivity/inbox/Welcome to Flowti.md'; const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path); if (!f) throw new Error('Welcome note not found: ' + path); const content = await app.vault.read(f); if (!content || content.trim().length === 0) throw new Error('Welcome note is empty'); if (!content.toLowerCase().includes('flowti')) throw new Error('Welcome note does not mention Flowti'); return 'ok'; })()

steps.title: Sample CSV was seeded with data rows
steps.description: Reads the supplier-overview.csv and verifies it contains data rows with expected column headers.
steps.expectedInput: Installer ran SeedContentStep with sample data
steps.expectedOutput: CSV file contains headers and at least 10 data rows

actions.code: (async () => { const path = '03 - Resources/Sample Data/supplier-overview.csv'; const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path); if (!f) throw new Error('CSV not found: ' + path); const content = await app.vault.read(f); const lines = content.trim().split('\n'); if (lines.length < 10) throw new Error('CSV too short: ' + lines.length + ' lines'); const header = lines[0].toLowerCase(); const expected = ['month', 'supplier', 'category']; for (const col of expected) { if (!header.includes(col)) throw new Error('Header missing column: ' + col); } return 'ok (' + lines.length + ' rows)'; })()
actions.description: Verify CSV has headers and data rows

steps.title: Test data CSVs are indexed by Obsidian
steps.description: Confirms that the analytics test CSV (generated by generate-test-data.mjs in globalSetup) is indexed by Obsidian.
steps.expectedInput: globalSetup generated test data, detectAllFileExtensions enabled
steps.expectedOutput: Suppliers.csv is accessible via vault API

actions.code: (() => { const path = '03 - Resources/Test Data/Analytics/Suppliers.csv'; if (!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path)) throw new Error('Test data CSV not found: ' + path); return 'ok'; })()
actions.description: Verify test data CSV is indexed
